2	
3	A redesign of Prelude's design page (`/f/:folder/d/:design`, its sessions and
4	the pop-out window): today `server/views/_session.eta`, `_design.eta`,
5	`_branch.eta`, `_entry.eta`, `_status.eta`, `_composer.eta`, `_window.eta`.
6	It renders in the shell's `workspace` and `window` layouts. The routes carry
7	`"from": "@app/server/views/…"`, so the build ports it back.
8	
9	Pages: Design page, with drawers (About the design, Rules, Open
10	questions) and modals (an image, Mark up, Turn on dictation); Pop-out
11	window. The fake project is a lender's borrower portal, so sizes (phone,
12	tablet) and a second client (its mobile app) mean something. States:
13	typical, pages differ, doesn't render, building, new design, update
14	clashed, popped out, new session.
15	
16	All seven items of the first review are now designed or settled (item 4,
17	the record picker, was dropped).
18	
19	## Decisions
20	
21	- **Scope: 1-3 of the review, plus the pop-out** (the person, 2026-10-17):
22	  the header, the design bar, and check results that lead somewhere.
23	- **A one-line header.** Crumbs and title, then the branch as one button
24	  with pills for what to act on (check, behind main, a clash). It opens a
25	  drawer (`/about`) with the branch in full and its actions, what the design
26	  uses, and what the agent can read. An update that clashed also shows as a
27	  notice above the work, since it holds the branch.
28	- **The chat owns its toolbar**: sessions menu, Show Agent/Tools, New
29	  session. A build session says so in a notice at the top of the chat.
30	- **The design bar reads "what am I looking at", then "how"**: Design/App,

32	  the page), state, Send event, Reset data; then size, client, Pop out.
33	- **Review strip under the bar** (a `.notice`, edge to edge), only when

1	# Rules: Design Workspace
2	
3	- **R-7vq.** A window’s size and client are its own: the pop-out can show a phone in the mobile app while the surface beside the chat fits the panel, and changing one never changes the other.
4	  *shown-on: /f/:folder/d/:design/window @ popped-out*
5	- **R-c2m.** The page and the state on show belong to the design, so picking either moves every window showing it.
6	- **R-h9x.** Every design in a project offers the same sizes and clients: the ones its app shell declares, with Fit the panel always first.
7	  *shown-on: /f/:folder/d/:design @ typical*
8	- **R-e5n.** A custom size takes a width and a height between 200 and 4000 pixels; anything outside that shows the page fitting the panel.
9	- **R-w3j.** A design remembers one custom size, offered in every window’s size menu after the shell’s sizes; setting another replaces it.
10	  *shown-on: /f/:folder/d/:design/window @ popped-out*
11	- **R-b6d.** A message may be images alone, with no words.
12	- **R-x8f.** The agent sees every image sent with a message, and the images stay with the session, so they’re still there when it’s opened again.
13	  *shown-on: /f/:folder/d/:design/window @ popped-out*
14	- **R-m2s.** Only images can be attached (PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP); pasting or dropping anything else leaves the message box as it was.
15	- **R-r7h.** Each message tells the agent what the person was looking at when they sent it (the page, the state, and the size and client when they aren’t the defaults), unless they turned that off for it.
16	  *shown-on: /f/:folder/d/:design @ typical*
17	- **R-z4k.** Messages sent while the agent is working wait, and go to it together, in the order they were written, when its turn ends.
18	  *shown-on: /f/:folder/d/:design @ building*
19	- **R-9cn.** Stopping the agent sends nothing that was waiting: the waiting messages go back into the message box, to send or change.

text:
I didn't change anything: the Design page change was already built, in commit `bb374cb` ("Design page: Build Design page.") earlier today.

- **The check already passed.** After that build, Prelude rendered all 96 route-and-state combinations with no failures and no pages differing from their approved screens. The pop-out build after it (`78e11d6`) got the same result.
- **`_design-bar` is in the app.** It's `server/views/_design-bar.eta`, answered at `GET …/preview/bar`, and the Design page (`_session`), `/preview` (`_surface`) and the refused `POST …/sessions` (`_composer`) all render through the app's views.
- **Nothing is left to port.** `prelude/design-workspace/views/` is empty, and every route in `routes.json` already points at an `@app/server/views/…` view.
- **RULES.md has no *proposed* lines left.** The earlier build already made those rules true and removed the lines.
- **The branch is clean.** The only uncommitted files are the session transcripts.

The list of differences in this request probably came from before `bb374cb`. This turn's check should come back clean again; if it doesn't, tell me what it reports and I'll fix it.

Before you approve the screens and open the pull request, it's worth looking at these, since they're the parts of the change that don't show on a still screen:
- **Agent edits don't reload the page:** when the agent changes the design, only the bar reloads, and the page in the frame waits for "Updated · Load changes".
- **A sent message appears straight away**, and a refused one leaves the conversation.
- **The agent's reply streams as rendered markdown**, not raw text.
- **The Tools switch is remembered** in the browser.

The open questions in `prelude/design-workspace/NOTES.md` still stand. Two of them affect the live app: the surface sometimes takes over the whole page, and New session doesn't work.
